crossRefs.note: But when Pharaoh saw that there was a respite, he hardened his heart, and didn’t listen to them, as Yahweh had spoken.
Pharaoh hardened his heart this time also, and he didn’t let the people go.
They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.
He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”
You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you…
“Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.
Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and wickedness as with cart rope,
who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel…
Let favor be shown to the wicked, yet he will not learn righteousness. In the land of uprightness he will deal…
“Whom have you dreaded and feared, so that you lie, and have not remembered me, nor laid it to your heart? Haven’t I…
“Moab has been at ease from his youth, and he has settled on his lees, and has not been emptied from vessel to vessel…
and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,
the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it, and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,
Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts
now therefore hear Yahweh’s word, O remnant of Judah: Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel, says, ‘If you indeed set…

translations.web: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
translations.bsb: When the sentence for a crime is not speedily executed, the hearts of men become fully set on doing evil.
translations.kjv: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.
